check.summary: Dry-run a grant against a registered engine action through governor.check; never uses an approval token and runs nothing.

validate-grant.summary: Validate a grant record against the shared contract.

status.summary: Report the pinned Headroom SDK requirement and whether it is installed; imports no SDK.

view.summary: Return a plain head/tail view of supplied text with every error line kept verbatim (ultra-context hr view); no SDK or tokenizer.

retrieve.summary: Read a stored original back from the private context store, verified against its SHA-256.

optimize.summary: Store an input file's original in the private context store and run the pinned SDK worker behind its no-IP boundary; passthrough when the SDK is absent.

route.summary: Classify an owner command (Arabic or English) into one engine, skill, workstreams and gates; unknown, ambiguous or negated targets stop with needs-clarification.

projects.summary: List public registry and private-overlay projects with their aliases.

plan.summary: Plan waves of (task, agent) pairs: duplicates dropped, dependencies first, no agent or write path twice in a wave.

simulate.summary: Simulate a wave plan over swarm/agents.json; starts no agent and calls no model.

next-wave.summary: Choose the next wave's agent count and batch from measured history and limits; zero agents means stop.

plan.summary: Plan a goal or gaie.spec/1 into milestones, tasks, roles, waves, least-privilege task grants and independent reviewers; nothing is started.

schedule.summary: Size the next wave of a verified plan from measured wave history and the host cap; nothing is started.

review-assignment.summary: Name the independent reviewer and approval panel of one plan task; never its implementer.

worktree-plan.summary: Return git worktree and branch commands (argv lists) per agent outside the repository; nothing is executed.

scenario-h.summary: Compute Scenario H figures from caller-supplied measured wave metrics; no file or clock is read.

supersedes: python3 -m engineering_os.orchestrator plan|scenario-h (kept as an ungoverned CLI)

list.summary: List catalog tools and local skills with lifecycle state; file presence is not operational proof.

search.summary: Search the validated external capability catalog.

recommend.summary: Recommend catalog capabilities, motions and skills that match a query.

integrations.summary: Report integration programs, protocols and their last recorded probes.

architecture.summary: Report the operating-system layer projection and its available sources.

status.summary: Report each layer's status from its latest receipt bound to current sources; runs nothing.

verify.summary: Run each layer's listed tests in subprocesses (not the governor sandbox) and write source-bound receipts to the private state directory.

spec.summary: Return the upgrade route for a scope (comprehensive, performance, self-healing) bound to the SHA-256 of the MASTER_UPGRADE prompt and gaie-upgrade skill.

plan.summary: Plan the factory stage graph and artifact/check contracts for an upgrade; no code is generated in this revision.

evaluate.summary: Revalidate supplied stage receipts against artifact bytes under artifact_root; artifacts are never executed.

components.summary: List implemented motion-lab components mapped to the catalog.

runtime.summary: Report motion runtime evidence (legacy and expansion) from reviewed, source-bound receipts only.

run-tests.summary: Run named hub unittest modules through governor.sandbox_run without network; tests may write temporary files and caches.

contracts.summary: Validate governance/engines.json (and governance/layers.json when present) against the shared contracts with imports resolved.

scan.summary: Static rules over the tracked files of this checkout (one hardened git ls-files read); hits by path, line and rule, never by value.

audit.summary: Static rules plus every registered finding's probe, re-run in private temporary directories (child processes, Python-level checks, not an OS sandbox).

anchor.summary: Record count and last record digest of the control plane's intact governor audit log; keep the anchor outside the state directory.

verify-anchor.summary: Check that the governor audit log is intact and still holds an anchored record (detects removal from its end).

supersedes: python3 -m engineering_os.security_audit (kept as an ungoverned CLI)

spec.summary: Return the registered release route (engine, skill, prompt, workstreams, gates, hub commands) bound to the SHA-256 of its skill and prompt files.

provenance.summary: Bind caller-supplied CI workflow-run and job metadata to the exact commit and required workflows; nothing is fetched.

eligibility.summary: Check a project's release evidence against its verified identity and clean checkout HEAD; reports eligibility and never deploys.

spec.summary: Return the registered audit route (engine, skill, prompt, workstreams, gates, hub commands) bound to the SHA-256 of its skill and prompt files.

inventory.summary: Bounded read-only inventory and upgrade coverage matrix of a project checkout; project code is never executed.

health.summary: Hub health projection, or a private project's offline capability integrity and manifests.

hub-audit.summary: Hub audit counts for catalog, skills, motions and integrations from their tested surfaces.

plan.summary: Rank caller-supplied alternatives against declared constraints and compute a dependency wave schedule.

review.summary: Decide a plan review from supplied independent reviews and verification receipts.

root-causes.summary: Rank root-cause candidates from supplied observations and dependencies.

put.summary: Store a curated project-scoped record (deduplicated, credential-shaped text refused).

search.summary: Lexical/concept retrieval within one project; recorded verification rechecked against source_root.

index.summary: Index Python symbols of one source file as memory records; source bodies are never stored.

checkpoint.summary: Write a checksummed snapshot of the memory store to a new private file.

restore.summary: Restore a checksummed snapshot into an empty memory store.

verify.summary: Attach a passed, source-bound test receipt to a stored solution.

parse.summary: Owner command or brief (Arabic or English) to gaie.spec/1 by deterministic lexicon matching; unknowns become open questions.

refine.summary: Resolve a spec's open questions with the owner's answers.

diff.summary: Change set between two specs for an upgrade, with breaking changes flagged.

acceptance.summary: Structured acceptance checks of a spec.

supersedes: python3 -m engineering_os.requirements (kept as an ungoverned CLI)

spec.summary: Return the build route bound to the SHA-256 of the MASTER_BUILD prompt and gaie-build skill.

plan.summary: Plan the factory stage graph and artifact/check contracts for a new system; no code is generated in this revision.

evaluate.summary: Revalidate supplied stage receipts against artifact bytes under artifact_root; artifacts are never executed.

analyze.summary: Propose evidence-bound repair hypotheses from supplied failures; no command or candidate code is executed.

verify-repair.summary: Check baseline, candidate and rollback copies in a disposable temporary workspace with fixed declarative checks; supplied code is never executed.

spec.summary: Return the registered cinematic route (engine, skill, prompt, workstreams, gates, hub commands) bound to the SHA-256 of its skill and prompt files.

audit.summary: Source-bound cinematic inventory; runtime eligibility only with fresh receipts for every requested browser.

inventory.summary: Count native engine motions (packages/motion-engines/registry.json) apart from Canvas2D reference motions.

validate.summary: Validate a gaie.storyboard/1 document and count its frames.

direct.summary: Static cinematic direction checks (reading time, pacing, language) of a storyboard.

subtitles.summary: WebVTT and SRT text of a storyboard for each language.

probe.summary: Probe headless Chromium (WebGL2, WebGPU, Arabic shaping) and local TTS in child processes; temporary files only.

render.summary: Render, encode and QA media into out_dir outside the repository (headless Chromium and ffmpeg child processes).

qa.summary: Measure one MP4 against an expected delivery format with ffprobe/ffmpeg child processes; temporary files only.

supersedes: python3 -m engineering_os.video_pipeline (kept as an ungoverned CLI)

summarize.summary: Aggregate a supplied ledger: tokens, estimates and charges kept separate; nothing is billed.

recommend-model.summary: Recommend a model through the gated model router from supplied registry and evidence; host credentials are never consulted.

ledger.summary: Read the control plane's private usage ledger rows.
